start.text: A board screwed to the Gannet's transom, painted black once, gone the flat grey of slate. Something was chalked on it. There's nothing there now but the grain.

choice.text: Hold the ember to the board.

read.text: You hold the ember close. Its warmth goes into the grey paint the way breath goes onto glass, only backward: the grey clears, and under it, letter by letter, the chalk comes back.
GANNET of Wrackholm. Sworn: HALE CORBET, master. ANNIS CORBET. RUAN PASK.
Three names you don't know. Somebody on this island will.

read_already.text: GANNET of Wrackholm. Sworn: HALE CORBET, master. ANNIS CORBET. RUAN PASK. The chalk stays where your light brought it back.

choice.text: Prise the board off the transom.

prised.text: Jory's pry bar lies on the torn copper. Two nails, and the board comes away in your hands: lighter than it ought to be, for three people.
Behind it the tar is cleaner, a square of it, the shape of where they were.

bare.text: The transom is bare where the board hung: a cleaner square of tar, two nail holes. The board's in your satchel.

choice.text: Put the board back on the transom.

bare.text: The transom is bare: a cleaner square of tar where something hung, two nail holes. You can't think what it was.

put_back.text: You set the board back on its nails and drive them home with the heel of your hand. The chalk stays where your light brought it back.
